summary_1line: Rama explains to Sita that he must keep his vow to protect the Dandaka forest ascetics from demons, even at the cost of his life.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands in the forest before Sita, solemnly declaring he would give up even his life rather than break his promise to the sages.
A group of frail ascetics in bark garments kneel before Rama in the Dandaka forest, pleading for protection from man-eating demons.
